items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for finite algebras over a local Noetherian ring, normality of the smaller algebra together with normality of the completion of the larger one implies normality of the completion of the smaller one (statement lines 3775-3781). The proof (proof lines 3783-3824) applies Serre's criterion, verifying the conditions (S2) and (R1) for the local rings of the completion through depth and flatness arguments in high dimension and faithful flatness of the larger algebra in low dimension. H3: a criterion verification with a two-case analysis, written out in full.
